notes.title: Update 0.5.1: No Place for Vampires
notes.notes:
In this patch, you can expect graphic improvements, overall balancing, some very meaningful bug fixes, and most importantly... more juice (including extra blood). Speaking of blood: every entity in the game now casts a shadow. Which leaves no doubt that there are NO vampires in our game, in case someone was wondering.

COMBAT UPDATES:

 "The Capelobo" is now harder to beat. Check it out.
 "The Capelobo" elite version implemented in Chaos Mode.
 Heavily improved Capelobo Cub's animation
 Relic synergy improved 


VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS:

 Enemies now draw more blood. 
 All entities now cast shadows.


OVERALL IMPROVEMENTS:

 Fixed all reported game breaking bugs.
 New loading tips
 Dialogue and localization improvements
 Audio mixing enhancements

notes.title: Update 0.5.0: Minibosses, Chaos Mode, and More
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is here! And to celebrate, we're releasing a huge demo update.

Minibosses, new challenges, and for those who thought the first biome was too easy... chaos mode. Time to show us how slick y'all are.

CHAOS MODE:

 You can now unlock The Statue in the Jungle by completing the demo (or finding it in the jungle).
 When you return to The Village, The Statue will be waiting for you.
 Giving it an offering will trigger Chaos Mode.
 In Chaos Mode, every enemy is an Elite enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/2bd77bd7b0a632fb7877cdf4af25d9322ba139bc.gif

NEW ENEMIES:

 New Miniboss: you can now face the mighty leader leader of the Capelobos.
 Elite Centipede implemented.
 Elite Capelobo Cub implemented.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/f27aab97b90e7b7cf4fa7f2b7600b667ece84abc.gif

COMBAT UPDATES:

 Spell rebalancing.
 Elite enemy graphics rework.
 Hit impact improvements.
 Enemies no longer damage you right after spawning.
 Player and projectiles now have silhouettes when behind objects.

GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS:

 Further FX and accessibility improvements.
 Collider/Warp bug fixes.
 Localization fixes.
 Sound mixing improvements.

And there's a lot more on the way. Like in some successful roguelike experiences, our main goal with the upcoming patches is to improve everything about the game with your help. This is a work-in-progress and an obsessive search for balance. We'll be here to hear your feedback. Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.4.2: The Big Combat Revamp
notes.notes:
The first demo week was amazing and with it came a lot of learnings. We spent the whole week balancing and tweaking mechanics while absorbing everyone's feedbacks. Shout out to @Retromation, @Haelian, and many others for their very insightful videos! And thanks to all of you who have been trying out our game.

In this new version, you can expect drastic combat tweaks for a more dynamic gameplay. You will also find accessibility improvements, and overall bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/9e6e8ba0072748b5a97960cf9a9ad05d07694831.gif

COMBAT IMPROVEMENTS:

 Enhanced controllability of all attacks
 Armadillo Body controllability heavily enhanced
 Wolf Arms attack speed and range increased
 Dashes/Attacks are now comboable (each body has its own combo window to be mastered)
 With some arm curses, you can now connect Strong Attacks to Quick Attacks.
 Next dash inputs are now stored for seamless combos
 Curse buffs from relics are now displayed on inventory


ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS:

 VFXs updates
 "Flashing lights" options are now available
 Scene lighting improvements
 Scenic transition improvements
 Audio mixing improvements


ENEMY IMPROVEMENTS:

 Overall smarter enemies
 Amarilis Ultra implemented! (the elite version of the flower shooter pal) 
 Capelobo Minion (the big anteater guy) HP and range increased
 Centipede pathfinder improvements
 Bug fixes

Leave us your impressions. Like in some successful roguelike experiences, our main goal with the upcoming patches is to improve our gameplay with your help. Know this is a work-in-progress and an obsessive search for balance. We'll be here to hear your feedback!

Thanks for being around at such an early moment of our journey. Stay tuned for the next update!
